name: the destination prefix spans two timezones that disagree right now
description: 208-555 sits under the 1208-5 map entry, which spans Boise (Mountain) and Los Angeles (Pacific). At 14:30 UTC it is 08:30 in one and 07:30 in the other, so withinHours is null. P1 is inconclusive with the timezone reason and nothing else is wrong, so the call is held, not blocked.

resolver.hoursBasis: prefix spans America/Boise, America/Los_Angeles and they disagree at this instant

call.why: Fictional 555-01XX number in the 208 area, chosen because tz-map.txt lists 12085 with two zones. At 16:00 UTC both zones would agree and the same number would resolve true.
